marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind northeast 20 knots diminishing to light near midnight. Wind
light Sunday. Periods of snow. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.text:
Wind northeast 15 knots backing to northwest 15 after midnight
then diminishing to light Sunday afternoon. Snow changing to scattered flurries near noon Sunday.
Visibility as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>
